name: generated-plugin
description: A plugin generated by the G-Assist Plugin Builder wizard. Replace this manifest with your own generated configuration.

functions.name: greet
functions.description: Greet the user with a personalized message. Use this when the user wants a greeting or says hello.

name.description: The name of the person to greet. Defaults to 'World'.

functions.name: count
functions.description: Count from 1 to a specified number, demonstrating streaming output. Use this when the user wants to see a counting demonstration.

count_to.description: The number to count to (1-20). Defaults to 5.

functions.name: start_conversation
functions.description: Start an interactive multi-turn conversation. Use this when the user wants to have a back-and-forth chat.

topic.description: The topic the user wants to talk about. Defaults to 'anything'.
